title: Chewing Gum Myth Busted

scenes.text: Your gum won't sit in your stomach for seven years.
People believe swallowed gum remains in the body for up to seven years.
scenes.label: Gum stays seven years

scenes.text: The digestive system can’t break gum but it passes through normally within days.
scenes.label: Gum passes in days
Out fast!
scenes.sub: Gum exits within a few days

scenes.text: Hit follow for your daily dose of wow.

description: Think chewing gum stays inside you for years? It actually moves on in just a few days. Stay curious and hit follow for more truth‑revealing facts.
